=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_det_skip_followup_guard.sh:det_skip_followup_merge_guard | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The guard's base.ref comes from workflow env captured at run start, not from a live read of the PR, and the function makes no API call.
  WHY: If the PR is retargeted after the run starts, the guard evaluates a stale base and can return allow for a base the PR no longer targets. (Source severity: MAJOR, confidence MEDIUM.)
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2499-2502 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: rb_judge_merge_retry_transient returns early when auto_merge_enabled is already true on the judged head, so the guard never re-runs.
  WHY: A PR armed before the follow-up security condition applied, or whose base changed while armed, is never re-evaluated, and GitHub merges when checks pass. (Source severity: MAJOR, confidence MEDIUM.)
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2466-2585 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: `gh pr merge --match-head-commit` binds the merge to the head SHA only, not the base, after the guard has checked base.ref.
  WHY: A retarget between the guard read and the merge still succeeds with the same head SHA, so a security follow-up could land on the wrong base. (Source severity: MAJOR, confidence MEDIUM.)
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2503-2510 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: It is unclear whether a transient `gh api` read failure yields an empty base and consumes a retry slot as a skipped attempt.
  WHY: The retry budget could be used up without a real merge attempt. This is fail-closed, but may not match the transient-error design. (Source severity: NIT, confidence LOW.)
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:2556-2585 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Each retry adds a `gh api` read, a subprocess and a temp file. Temp file cleanup on every return path was not verified.
  WHY: The cost is negligible with at most 3 retries. A leaked temp file would accumulate only across runs on the same runner. (Source severity: NIT, confidence LOW.)
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:rb_judge_followup_merge_guard; .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: `SINGLE_PASS_FOLLOWUP_GUARD_SWITCH` is forwarded into `SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED`, so two kill-switch names exist for one behaviour.
  WHY: An operator who sets the wrong name may misjudge whether the guard is on. Merge safety is unchanged. (Source severity: NIT, confidence HIGH.)
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:rb_judge_followup_merge_guard | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The guard script path `${SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR:-scripts}/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh` defaults to a path relative to the working directory, and the judge-step export of `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR` was not confirmed.
  WHY: If the working directory holds PR-head content, a PR could supply its own guard script that prints `allow`. (Source severity: MAJOR, confidence LOW. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash refuted this: line 20 defaults SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR to /tmp/codex-support.)
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: The judge step must export or resolve `SUPPORT_SCRIPTS_DIR` to the trusted, SHA-verified support-script directory.
  expected_change_site: the judge step env in .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, and scripts/review_rb_judge.sh
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: a repo-wide grep shows many uses, but no confirmed export in the judge step.
- requirement: The sync site mapping near scripts/review_rb_judge.sh lines 3207 and 3364 must route through the same guard.
  expected_change_site: the sync-path merge sites in scripts/review_rb_judge.sh
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: not checked in this review.
- requirement: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml stays under the 480,000-byte guard (§24).
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: the byte count was not measured. The change adds guard calls, env wiring, and a sparse-checkout entry.
- requirement: The `--merge --auto` segment must have guard test coverage matching the `--squash --auto` segment.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_review_rb_judge_head_binding.py; tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: the new guard tests were not confirmed to exercise the `--merge` path, and no test executes the deterministic-skip `--merge` segment with a stub guard result. test_det_skip_merge_step_runs_followup_guard_before_both_auto_merges (tests/test_single_issue_security_pass.py:1647) checks it only textually.
- requirement: The new det-skip library must be in the sparse checkout and in the required-bootstrap and contract-test registries (§24).
  expected_change_site: the workflow sparse-checkout list and the bootstrap test registry
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: the sparse-checkout addition is recorded. Registry entries were not verified.
- requirement: The pre-push failure in tests/test_ai_label_precreation_contract.py must be fixed, or shown to be unrelated to this change.
  expected_change_site: the pre-push gate result
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: the editor attributed the failure to a sandbox-excluded `label_contract.v1.json` without verifying that attribution.
- requirement: The agents fragment `agents.d/9671-security-followup-guard-merge-sites.md` must target an existing `## ` heading in the §25 marker format.
  expected_change_site: the fragment marker line
  confidence=2
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: the heading match was not verified.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
